Correctly expand the right-hand side:
\[
(2011-n)(2a_1+d(2010-n))
= d n^2-(2a_1+4021d)n+2011(2a_1+2010d).
\]
The left side is
\[
n(2a_1+d(n-1))=d n^2+(2a_1-d)n.
\]
Comparing coefficients gives
\[
2a_1-d=-(2a_1+4021d),
\]
so
\[
a_1=-1005d.
\]

For the geometric sequence, take \(n=11\):
\[
P_{11}=P_{12}.
\]
Since \(P_{12}=P_{11}b_{12}\) and \(P_{11}\neq 0\), we get
\[
b_{12}=1.
\]

\[
\boxed{1}
\]
